per_window.ps-ns: dynamic_in_window. The free domain at 25 °C is ordered with local fast motion: S2 drops in the HII-HIII loop E42-E44 and the beta-sheet V28-T30/E61-I63 (SIGA-J1, r2), both termini carry a ~1 ns second internal mode (J2), and D46 has tau_e 0.9 ± 0.2 ns (J3). Second-mode times in the ordered regions are poorly determined (J4, unresolved). Per-residue values are figure-only.
per_window.us-ms: dynamic_in_window. Model-free Rex at three fields places exchange in helix I and the regions packed against it (J5, r2); 15N CPMG fits a two-state process, kex ~3,500 (printed as Hz), pB 1.5%, 15N shift differences 2-6 ppm, largest at the end of helix I, in helix II and the beta-sheet (J6, r3). Both residue sets are figure-only, so the region stays unlocalized. A 2023 abstract reports a temperature-dependent partially unfolded minor state (J7, r1, undetermined window).
per_window.slower_than_ms: search_insufficient: no H/D exchange or other slow measurement (J8).
per_window.undetermined: J7 (abstract-only minor state). Not judged: the RDC/NOE structure ensemble 5MWW (r4, dominant conformation only), the computational placement of 5MWW in the RNAP channel, which the authors say needs minimal rearrangement (r5, modelled, not measured), and the T. maritima versus E. coli homolog fold comparison (r6, homolog, no target rate).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Yes: the free wild-type domain 1.1 (author 1-71 plus LE-His6, 25 °C, buffer and pH not stated) shows 15N CPMG dispersion fit by a two-state model with kex about 3,500 (printed as Hz) and a 1.5% minor state, with the largest shift differences (2-6 ppm) at the end of helix I, in helix II and in the beta-sheet; the residue set is figure-only, so the region is unlocalized, and the minor state's structure is unknown.
protein_summary.deposition_readback: Deposition-derived; same numbers RelaxDB labels were computed from; not literature confirmation. BMRB 27011, which the 2017 paper names as the deposition of its relaxation rates and order parameters, holds R1, R2 and NOE lists at 600, 850 and 950 MHz for up to 70 residues at 298.2 K, pH 6.6 and 10 mM ionic strength (the pH appears only in the deposition). In all three R2 lists the error column exceeds the value in most rows (46 of 67, 67 of 70, 43 of 69), so the columns may be swapped or mislabelled; R1 and NOE values are listed but no R2/R1 screen was run.
open_conflicts: Not a conflict yet: the 2023 abstract gives 4% of molecules in the partially unfolded minor state at room temperature (J7, r1), against 1.5% at 25 °C by CPMG in 2017 (J6, r3); the same process cannot be assumed from an abstract.
Minor-state structure: the authors speculate it may resemble the T. maritima fold (r3, r6) and give no evidence for it.
questions_for_gina: Are the deposited 27011 R2 values and errors swapped (error larger than value in most rows), and should the RelaxDB labels for this entry be recomputed or flagged?
Is the 2023 Proteins paper on the transitionally occupied state (r1) worth retrieving in full to place its minor state against the 2017 CPMG result?
protein_summary.buffer_note: The 2017 paper gives 25 °C but no buffer or pH in the main text (the deposition lists pH 6.6, 10 mM ionic strength). kex is printed as '~3,500 Hz'; it is kept as printed. The construct carries a non-native LE plus His6 tail (entry 72-73 = LE). Figure 2 and Figure 3 residue profiles are figure-only, so no complete residue list exists for Rex, S2 or dispersion.
